task: T3: record every launched run in the registry, from inside `dispatch` in scripts/dispatch/dispatcher.py. Add a keyword argument `registry_path` to `dispatch`, and after a Job is launched write one record naming the event id, the repo, the spec, the strategy, the rendered Job's name, and a coarse status derived from the launch exit status — the literal `launched` when the apply command succeeded and the literal `failed` when it did not. Thread the same new keyword argument through `handle_event` so the chat path records runs too. A run that is skipped because the event id was already seen must NOT produce a second record — the registry says what was launched, and a replayed event launches nothing. When no registry path is supplied the dispatcher must still work and simply not record, so that an existing caller does not break. Change nothing about the ledger, the renderer or the launcher in this task.
